Package io.jans.lock.model.trace.api

Class TraceRecordResponse

java.lang.Object
io.jans.lock.model.trace.api.TraceRecordResponse
public class TraceRecordResponse extends Object
A single TRACE record envelope (design §10, §11.2, TRACE MVP task 21): the stored assertion plus the verification outcome and the Lock-derived ingestion metadata. assertion is the request body text re-parsed as a JSON value, never re-serialized by hand (design decision D-13): Jackson re-emits it, so semantic identity with the originally signed bytes is preserved, not byte-for-byte identity.
Author:
Yuriy Movchan
